[NADP.5.2.1] On shutdown the adapter:

1. Stops accepting new source-system events.
2. Drains in-flight outbound work (or cancels with
   `CallError ruleset_reload` / `engine_shutdown`).
3. Unregisters its callbacks (set cb = NULL on the
   relevant `ds_engine_set_*_callback` calls).
4. Closes the source-system connection.
5. The engine itself is freed by the integrator
   after all adapters have unregistered, via
   `ds_engine_free`.
